name: How much does an Uber accident attorney cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does an Uber accident attorney cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most Uber accident attorneys work on a contingency fee basis. This means you do not pay any upfront legal fees. Instead, the attorney's fees are a percentage of the final settlement or court award you receive. If your case is unsuccessful, you typically do not owe any attorney fees. This arrangement allows accident victims to pursue justice without worrying about hourly rates or large retainers, ensuring legal representation is accessible. The specific percentage is agreed upon at the start of the representation.
